summary: Frontend-only regression of reports.tsx refactor (web preview 390x844). LIVE POS for BOTH tenants (Merkez, Gümüşhane) is NOT processing report jobs right now: every report-run returns pending/status=queued (Fiyat Listeleri queued >5.5 min, backend logs show 'Detay zamanında gelmedi' for all of today's runs) and cache_only returns 0 rows -> no live data could be obtained (infra/POS issue, not a frontend bug). To still verify the refactored result UI, /api/data/report-run was intercepted with Playwright page.route and fed TEST_ fixture rows (MOCKED IN TEST ONLY; app code untouched). With that, every requested flow passed: N kayıt counter + freshness badge, cards, Sırala pills (asc/desc/Temizle), search 'X kayıt · toplam Y' + clear, back-to-filters/close, required filter alert + Lokasyon picker, Gelir Tablosu hierarchy, Fiş Kalem headers + SATIŞ/ALIŞ banners, Personel TOPLAM SATIŞ banner, Excel .xlsx download, PDF popup. The real (unmocked) pending screen and 'Beklemeyi İptal Et' also work. 0 console errors / pageerrors in all runs.
